description: Return the anyURI value in a Unicode normalization form, as ECMAScript s.normalize(form) does. Every Adaptive string is already NFC, so form "NFC" (the default) returns it as a string; "NFKC" also replaces compatibility characters ("ﬁ" becomes "fi", "①" becomes "1"). "NFD" and "NFKD" are errors: a string in Adaptive Script is always NFC, so a decomposed result can not be a string.

errorsThrown.reason: form is not NFC or NFKC

returns.description: The normalized value, as a string.
